name: Agent Skills (Anthropic official documentation)
summary: Anthropic's reference for Agent Skills, which are reusable folders of instructions, metadata and optional scripts or templates that Claude loads on demand when a task is relevant. It explains the SKILL.md structure and where custom skills work: the Claude API, Claude Code and claude.ai.
install_steps: Create a folder for the skill with a SKILL.md file inside it
Start SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter that sets a name and a description
Write the step-by-step instructions and examples below the frontmatter
In Claude Code, place the folder in ~/.claude/skills/ (personal) or .claude/skills/ (project)
On claude.ai, upload the skill as a zip file; custom skills need a plan with code execution enabled
example_use_case: Package your team's repeatable review checklist as a skill so Claude applies it when relevant, instead of you pasting the same instructions into every conversation.
